tasks.name: Ingestion - NB_Setup_ServiceDesk
tasks.description: Ingestion layer. The setup notebook loads the generated CSVs (world.yaml, seed 42) straight into the lakehouse as typed Delta tables, graph edge tables included. No separate transform step: ingestion lands the data ready to model.

tasks.name: Lakehouse - LH_ServiceDesk
tasks.description: Batch layer. Customers, sites, users, devices, applications, tickets, contracts, XLAs and agents, plus the weekly history the zero-touch and credit figures are computed from.

tasks.name: Live signals - EH_ServiceDesk
tasks.description: Eventhouse and KQL database KQL_ServiceDesk. Six live tables (DEM telemetry, tickets, conversations, CSAT, agent traces, gateway logs), history preloaded, then streamed by inject_event.

tasks.name: Ontology - ONT_ServiceDesk
tasks.description: Fabric IQ ontology and its graph. 13 entity types bound to the lakehouse, TimeSeries on Device and Agent bound to the Eventhouse, so one question crosses batch and live.

tasks.name: Semantic model - SM_ServiceDesk_Analytics
tasks.description: Direct Lake model. Zero-touch rate, XLA breaches and service credits are defined here once, as named DAX measures: Fabrikam 34.0 percent and 9250 EUR, Litware 38.0 percent and no credit.

tasks.name: Report - RPT_ServiceDesk
tasks.description: Three pages: Service Desk Overview, Experience and Incidents, XLA and Credits. The human view of the same measures the agent quotes.

tasks.name: Real-Time Dashboard - RTD_ServiceDesk_Operations
tasks.description: Operations and AgentOps pages over KQL_ServiceDesk, 30 second auto-refresh.

tasks.name: Alerts - ACT_ServiceDesk_Alerts and OA_ServiceDesk_Ops
tasks.description: Activator rule on site VPN latency above 200 ms (5 minute average), sent to Teams, and the Operations Agent that watches the live tables.

tasks.name: Data agent - ServiceDesk_Analyst
tasks.description: Answers how far zero-touch fell, only with figures computed in Fabric: GQL on the ontology, DAX on the semantic model, KQL on the Eventhouse. Published, with an MCP endpoint.

tasks.name: Console - App-Zava-Service-Desk
tasks.description: The service desk console. Evaluates the named DAX measures and calls the data agent; it never computes a rate, a credit or a threshold itself.

name: Zava Service Desk - signal to credit
description: Managed service desk analytics: batch history and live signals, modelled once in Fabric, answered by a data agent and shown in the console. Only Fabric items are mapped; the contracts side of the story is not a Fabric item and stays off this canvas.
